dmn_experiences.title: A Tasting Tour of London's Craft Breweries
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Bermondsey's beer mile, visiting four taprooms with tutored tastings led by an accredited Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone. Groups are limited to 14 people.
highlights: Visits four taprooms on Bermondsey's beer mile
Tutored tastings led by a Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone
Learn about beer styles, history and how to evaluate beer
Small groups of up to 14 people

dmn_experiences.title: Historic London Pub Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided walk through four of the City of London's most historic pubs, drinking your way through 2,000 years of the capital's story — from the founding of Londinium to a medieval friary, a 16th-century tavern rebuilt after the Great Fire, and the pub that hid the Crown Jewels through two World Wars. Groups are capped at 10 and the tour is for over-18s.
dmn_experiences.description_md:
London has one of the world's great pub cultures, and some of these houses have been trading for more than 400 years. This tour takes in the hidden gems, the literary haunts, the pubs with a nefarious story behind them, and the ones pouring both traditional cask and new-wave craft beer.

Groups of up to ten are guided personally around four classic pubs, starting at St Paul's and working through the City. You'll drink in the site of a former medieval Dominican friary, sit by an open fire in a 16th-century pub rebuilt after the Great Fire of London, visit the pub where the Crown Jewels were kept safe during two World Wars, and finish in the luxurious splendour of an old gin palace.

Most of what you'll see isn't in the guidebooks.

highlights: Four classic City of London pubs, guided in person
2,000 years of history, from Roman Londinium onwards
Drink on the site of a medieval Dominican friary
Sit by the fire in a 16th-century pub rebuilt after the Great Fire
See the pub where the Crown Jewels were hidden during two World Wars
Small groups of up to 10 people, over-18s only

dmn_experiences.title: The Official Coyote Ugly Bottomless Brunch — Camden
dmn_experiences.summary: Ninety minutes of bottomless pizza, prosecco and beer at the official Coyote Ugly Saloon in Camden, with a line-dancing lesson from the bar's Coyotes on Saturdays. Over-18s only.
dmn_experiences.description_md:
Saddle up, Camden. The official Coyote Ugly Saloon runs its Nashville Hoedown bottomless brunch on Camden High Street, and it is exactly as loud as it sounds.

Your ticket covers 90 minutes of bottomless pizza, bubbles and pints, served while the bar's Coyotes work the counter. On Saturdays you also get a line-dancing lesson thrown in.

Sessions run through the afternoon and sell out on peak weekends, so book ahead if you want a particular slot. Over-18s only.
